module.name: F5 SPK Egress Configuration
module.description: Creates F5SPKEgress custom resource for configuring egress traffic routing with SNAT pools and destination control.

required.reason: FLO provides F5SPKEgress CRD and controller

optional.reason: Egress config can reference SNAT pools
optional.provides: SNAT pool resources for source NAT

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Name of the Kubernetes cluster (used for resource identification)

required.name: flo_ready
required.description: Dependency flag ensuring FLO is ready

optional.name: snat_pool_ref
optional.description: Reference to F5SPKSnatpool resource for source NAT

optional.name: allowed_destinations
optional.description: List of allowed destination CIDR ranges

key_outputs.name: egress_ready
key_outputs.description: Flag indicating egress configuration is active

key_outputs.name: egress_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the created egress configuration

key_outputs.name: egress_namespace
key_outputs.description: Namespace where egress config is deployed
